answer: Identity bonds that decay stop fake agents. A new agent posts a 60-token bond, like planting an orchard: it grows only with honest work and decays if the agent goes silent. To forge one identity costs 60 tokens, and past behaviour must echo in public records checked by peers, or the bond is burned. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 tokens, far above flooding rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
